tells: Stuffs the real brand ('allegrolokalnie') into a subdomain so it looks right at a glance on a phone.
Actual registered domain is a random 9-digit number ('aukcja758487593') on a bargain-bin '.top' TLD.
Path '/logowanie/48819' mimics a specific Polish login/listing ID.
items.critic_note: Putting 'allegrolokalnie' in front of 'aukcja758487593.top' is the web equivalent of taping a Gucci logo over a cardboard box. It relies entirely on mobile browsers truncating everything after the first word.

tells: Five hyphenated buzzwords ('walletsupport-ledger-live-login-ch') crammed into one subdomain.
Hosted on 'vercel.app' — a free developer hosting platform, not Ledger's domain.
Real hardware wallet support never asks you to 'log in' via a web URL.
items.critic_note: Nothing screams 'official hardware security' like a 34-character hyphen-salad hosted on a free hobbyist tier. If a domain has more dashes than a Morse code message, keep walking.

rejected_log.reason: Human review caught '_phishme.com_session_id' cookie in scan metadata — likely a corporate phishing simulation/training domain, not a criminal knockoff. Excluded from the main aisle.
